name: com.imperioutils/fisco-it
title: Imperio — Italian Tax & Compliance Tools
description: Free, deterministic Italian tax tools for agents: CF, P.IVA, IBAN, ATECO, IVA, IMU, F24, NIS2.

tools.name: validate_codice_fiscale
tools.description: Validates an Italian Codice Fiscale (tax code): 16 characters (individuals: format, check character, omocodia, date and place of birth) or 11 digits (companies and entities: same check as the Partita IVA). Formal check only: it does NOT say whether the code was issued or to whom (the limit is stated in the response, in `non_verificato`). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

codice_fiscale.description: The Codice Fiscale to validate (e.g. RSSMRA85T10A562S).

tools.name: generate_codice_fiscale
tools.description: Generates an Italian Codice Fiscale from personal data (surname, first name, date of birth, sex, and municipality/foreign country of birth — or the Belfiore code directly). Returns the "base" code (the omocodia variant used in case of collision is assigned by the Agenzia delle Entrate). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

comune.description: Municipality (or foreign country) of birth. Alternatively use codice_belfiore.

provincia.description: Province code (e.g. PI) to disambiguate municipalities with the same name.

codice_belfiore.description: Cadastral/Belfiore code of the place of birth (precise alternative to comune).

tools.name: validate_partita_iva
tools.description: Validates an Italian Partita IVA (VAT number: 11 digits + Luhn checksum; accepts the IT prefix). Formal check only: it does NOT say whether the VAT number is active or ceased (the limit is stated in the response, in `non_verificato`). For a VAT number of another EU country use `verify_payee` (VIES). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

partita_iva.description: The Partita IVA to validate: 11 digits, with or without the IT prefix (e.g. 12345678903 or IT12345678903).

vat_number.description: Alias di `partita_iva` (Partita IVA): stesso dato, accettato perché altri tool di questo server lo chiamano così. Se mandi entrambi i nomi, i valori devono coincidere.

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Validates a European IBAN (country length + MOD-97 checksum); for Italian and San Marino IBANs it also checks the CIN, and for Italian ones it identifies the bank from the ABI code. Formal check only: it does NOT say whether the account exists or who holds it (the limit is stated in the response, in `non_verificato`). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

tools.name: lookup_cap
tools.description: Returns the province of the 2-digit PREFIX of an Italian CAP (postal code). If the prefix belongs to a single province it is named in `provincia_prefisso`; if it is shared by several provinces (e.g. 23 = Sondrio or Lecco, 20 = Milano or Monza-Brianza) `provincia_prefisso` is null, `stato_provincia` is "incerta" (uncertain) and `province_possibili` lists the candidates. It does NOT return the municipality (`comune` is always null: we have no CAP→municipality table). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

tools.name: validate_pec
tools.description: Validates an Italian PEC (certified email) address: format + domain checked against the list of AGID-certified providers (Aruba, InfoCert, Namirial, Poste, etc.). `is_pec_domain` has THREE values: true (in the AGID list), false (not a PEC), null (the domain contains 'pec' but was NOT verified — not the same as false). The domain is checked, not the mailbox (`non_verificato` in the response). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

email.description: The PEC address to validate (e.g. mario.rossi@pec.it).

tools.name: lookup_ateco
tools.description: Looks up and validates an ISTAT ATECO activity code (2007/2022 or 2025) and returns its description and hierarchy, with the official correspondence between the two editions: for an ATECO 2007/2022 code, the corresponding ATECO 2025 codes in `ateco_2025` (`copertura` TOTALE or PARZIALE = full or partial coverage, `ambiguo` if there is more than one); for an ATECO 2025 code, the corresponding 2007/2022 code, to which the forfettario coefficients are tied. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

code.description: The ATECO 2007/2022 or 2025 code (digits and dots only, e.g. 62.01).

ateco.description: Alias di `code` (codice ATECO): stesso dato, accettato perché altri tool di questo server lo chiamano così. Se mandi entrambi i nomi, i valori devono coincidere.

codice_ateco.description: Alias di `code` (codice ATECO): stesso dato, accettato perché altri tool di questo server lo chiamano così. Se mandi entrambi i nomi, i valori devono coincidere.

tools.name: search_ateco
tools.description: Full-text search over ISTAT ATECO 2007/2022 codes starting from the activity DESCRIPTION, in Italian ("fotografo", "sviluppo software", "commercio abbigliamento") instead of the code. Case/accent-insensitive, with stemming and colloquial per-trade aliases; also accepts a code prefix. Use this when the code is NOT known — `lookup_ateco` covers the opposite case (known code → description). Results ordered by relevance. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

q.description: Activity to search for, in Italian (e.g. 'fotografo', 'idraulico', 'consulenza informatica').

query.description: Alias di `q` (testo da cercare): stesso dato, accettato perché altri tool di questo server lo chiamano così. Se mandi entrambi i nomi, i valori devono coincidere.

section.description: Filter by ATECO section (letter A–U, e.g. J = information and communication services, M = professional activities). Optional.

tools.name: calc_forfettario
tools.description: Computes the substitute tax and INPS contributions of the Italian regime forfettario (flat-rate scheme) from turnover. With `ateco` or `coefficiente`: the exact calculation, with deadlines and advance payments. With `ricavi` only: a TABLE with the calculation for each statutory profitability coefficient (`modalita: 'tabella_per_coefficiente'`, field `scenari`), because the coefficient depends on the activity and has no default. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

ateco.description: ATECO code from which the profitability coefficient is derived. ALTERNATIVE to `coefficiente`. With neither, the response is the per-coefficient table, not the exact calculation.

codice_ateco.description: Alias di `ateco` (codice ATECO): stesso dato, accettato perché altri tool di questo server lo chiamano così. Se mandi entrambi i nomi, i valori devono coincidere.

coefficiente.description: Profitability coefficient in % (manual override). ALTERNATIVE to `ateco`. With neither, the response is the per-coefficient table.

startup.description: Reduced 5% rate for new businesses: applies to the starting year and the following four (default false → 15%). It does not change the advance payments: none are due in the first year of activity, and the response notes say so.

gestione_inps.description: INPS pension scheme or professional fund (optional).

contributi_cassa_privata.description: Private professional fund contributions already paid, in euro (optional).

tools.name: parse_fatturapa
tools.description: Extracts structured data (seller, buyer, lines, taxes) from a FatturaPA/SDI XML e-invoice. Deterministic parsing only — no VIES check. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

xml_content.description: The XML content of the electronic invoice (FatturaPA/SDI).

tools.name: parse_verify_fatturapa
tools.description: Extracts structured data from a FatturaPA/SDI XML e-invoice AND, in the same call, runs an anti-fraud check on the chosen party (default: the CEDENTE, i.e. the supplier who receives the bank transfer). The checked data are NOT inferred by an LLM: VAT number, Codice Fiscale, company name and payment IBAN are extracted deterministically from the XML, then passed to the checks: IBAN (MOD-97 checksum + bank from the ABI code), VAT number and CF (checksum) and — when the EU service is reachable — the real registered name via live VIES, compared with the one stated on the invoice. Returns the full parse plus `supplier_verification` with a verdict (ok / non_verificabile / attenzione / alto_rischio = ok / not verifiable / caution / high risk) and specific red flags; if the invoice carries several distinct IBANs it flags it and lowers the verdict. It is the defence against the IBAN-change fraud on incoming invoices. Like `verify_payee` it performs external I/O (a single VIES query per call, not one per line): if VIES is down or the shared budget is exhausted the verdict degrades HONESTLY to "attenzione", never to a false "ok". Free (€0), no login. It does NOT replace out-of-band verification (a phone call to the supplier on an already known number).

xml_content.description: The XML content of the electronic invoice (FatturaPA/SDI). A .p7m must be unwrapped first: plain-text XML only.

party.description: Party to check: 'cedente' = supplier/payee (default, the anti-fraud case); 'cessionario' = customer. The IBAN is collected only for the cedente, because the cedente is the one who gets paid.

expected_country.description: Expected supplier country, ISO2. If omitted, the country stated by the invoice itself (the cedente's seat) applies, and only failing that 'IT'. A foreign IBAN on a supplier expected to be Italian is fraud warning sign #1.

tools.name: calc_iva
tools.description: Computes Italian IVA (VAT) on a taxable amount (rates 22/10/5/4/0/exempt/out of scope), with optional withholding tax (self-employed 20%, agents 11.5%), and decides the TERRITORIALITY of cross-border transactions: goods or services, business or consumer, EU or non-EU → taxable in Italy, non-taxable, out of scope or VAT of the destination country (official TEDB standard rate of the 27 Member States), with FatturaPA Natura code, invoice wording and legal reference. EU €10,000 threshold not declared → two scenarios computed, never a number chosen on your behalf. Cited laws follow the transaction date: DPR 633/72 until 31/12/2026, Testo unico IVA from 1/1/2027. Handles the TWO taxable bases of a professional's invoice (professional fund contribution only in the VAT base, INPS recharge in both). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

imponibile.description: Fee/consideration in EUR (e.g. 1000), NET of the professional fund contribution and of the INPS recharge: those are added with the two dedicated fields.

tipo_operazione.description: Transaction type (default b2b). intraUE REQUIRES `cessionario_soggetto_iva`; towards an EU consumer it also requires `oggetto`. extraUE without `oggetto` is treated as an export of goods (stated in `presupposti`); for services declare `oggetto` and `cessionario_soggetto_iva`: towards a non-EU consumer the VAT is as a rule Italian.

cessionario_soggetto_iva.description: REQUIRED for tipo_operazione='intraUE' (and for extraUE with oggetto='servizi'). true = taxable person with a VAT number valid in VIES: goods non-taxable (N3.2), services out of scope (N2.1). false = private consumer: the VAT is Italian or of the destination country depending on `oggetto`, `vendita_a_distanza`, `soglia_ue_superata` and `tipo_servizio`.

contributo_integrativo_pct.description: Rate % of the professional fund's integrative contribution (default 0 = no fund). Typically 4; 5 for surveyors (geometri); 2 for ENPAP/ENPAV — read it from the fund's rules: the tool does not infer it from ATECO. It enters the VAT base but NOT the withholding base.

rivalsa_inps_pct.description: Rate % of the INPS gestione separata recharge billed on the invoice (default 0). By law 4 (art. 1 c. 212 L. 662/1996). It enters BOTH bases.

oggetto.description: For intraUE/extraUE. It changes the regime: intra-EU B2B supply of goods = non-taxable (N3.2, «operazione non imponibile»); B2B services = out of scope (N2.1, «inversione contabile»). Required towards an EU consumer.

paese_destinazione.description: ISO2 of the customer's country ('EL' Greece; 'XI' Northern Ireland = EU for goods only). Used for the destination rate above the threshold.

vendita_a_distanza.description: Goods to an EU consumer: true if transport is by or on behalf of the seller (default assumed true, and stated). false = the customer transports them → Italian VAT.

soglia_ue_superata.description: Distance sales and electronic services to EU consumers: true if distance sales + TBE services to EU consumers exceeded €10,000 (previous or current year) OR if you opted for destination VAT. If you do not declare it you get TWO computed scenarios and `iva_importo: null`.

tipo_servizio.description: For oggetto='servizi'. generico = general rule (default assumed, and stated); elettronico = telecommunications, broadcasting, electronic services; speciale = real estate, transport, catering, events, vehicle hire, intermediation, work on movable goods — the tool does NOT compute the place of supply and says so, citing the laws.

servizio_7_septies.description: Services to a non-EU consumer: true if the service is one of those in art. 7-septies (consulting, advertising, data, financial, staff, hire of movable goods…): out of scope.

aliquota_destinazione_pct.description: Rate of the destination country, if the goods have a REDUCED rate there. Without it, the official standard rate (TEDB) is used and the response says so.

data_operazione.description: YYYY-MM-DD, default today. It decides the cited law: DPR 633/72 and DL 331/93 until 31/12/2026, Testo unico IVA (D.Lgs. 10/2026) from 1/1/2027.

tools.name: calc_reverse_charge
tools.description: Computes the VAT the BUYER (cessionario) must self-assess under the Italian reverse charge and returns both parties' obligations with the applicable law. It separates the three cases most often confused: INTRA-EU reverse charge (non-IT EU supplier — art. 46 DL 331/93 for goods, art. 17 c. 2 DPR 633/72 for services: with 'oggetto' it also says how the supplier invoices and which integration document is needed), DOMESTIC reverse charge (Italian supplier — art. 17 c. 6, which is NOT general: it applies only in listed sectors such as construction subcontracting, scrap, building cleaning, electronics) and non-EU country (explicit error, not an implicit branch). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

imponibile.description: Taxable amount of the invoice in EUR.

paese_cedente.description: ISO2 code of the SUPPLIER's (cedente) country: an EU Member State (e.g. DE, FR, ES; 'EL' or 'GR' for Greece; 'XI' for Northern Ireland) for the intra-EU reverse charge, or 'IT' for the domestic one.

oggetto.description: intraUE only: 'beni' (goods) or 'servizi' (services). For goods the EU supplier invoices an exempt intra-EU supply (integration TD18); for services «inversione contabile» (TD17). If missing, the response gives both cases in `per_oggetto`.

tools.name: calc_split_payment
tools.description: Computes the split payment (scissione dei pagamenti) for supplies to the Italian Public Administration (art. 17-ter DPR 633/72): the supplier invoices taxable amount + VAT but collects from the PA ONLY the taxable amount, while the PA pays the VAT directly to the Treasury. Returns the two amounts separately, the cash-flow impact for the supplier and the FatturaPA instructions (EsigibilitaIVA=S; the N6 Natura codes are NOT used, they belong to the reverse charge only). It does NOT apply to self-employed fee invoices with withholding tax (art. 17-ter c. 1-sexies): for a professional use calc_iva with con_ritenuta. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

imponibile.description: Taxable amount of the supply to the PA in EUR.

aliquota_iva.description: VAT rate shown on the invoice (default 22).

tools.name: calc_imu
tools.description: Computes Italian IMU property tax (L.160/2019) for buildings (from cadastral income + category), agricultural land (from reddito dominicale) and building land (from market value), with first/second instalment. The rate (‰) is the one set by the municipality: pass it (`aliquota_permille`) OR pass the `comune` (cadastral code or name) and the server uses the rate from its prospetto published by the MEF, with its legal status (prospetto of the year · previous year, L.160/2019 c.767 · base rates) and the source in `aliquota_comune`. If the prospetto has not been read yet, or the municipality has no IMU (Trento, Bolzano, Friuli Venezia Giulia), it answers `calcolato: false` with the explanation, without an amount. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

aliquota_permille.description: Rate set by the municipality, per thousand (e.g. 8.6 for 8.6‰). REQUIRED if you do not pass `comune`; with both, this one wins, and the response says whether it differs from the prospetto.

comune.description: Cadastral code (e.g. B519) or name of the municipality. The rate becomes the one in its IMU prospetto published by the MEF for the year (or, by law, the previous year's or the base rate).

provincia.description: Province code, for municipalities with the same name (e.g. TO). Only with `comune`.

ex_comune.description: Only merged municipalities with differentiated rates: the former municipality where the property is. If needed and missing, the response lists the possible ones.

anno.description: Tax year of the per-municipality verdict (default the current year). Only with `comune`.

tipo_immobile.description: Property type → selects the formula (default abitazione_non_principale).

categoria_catastale.description: Buildings only: cadastral category as on the visura, without the slash (A/2 → `A2`, C/1 → `C1`). It sets the multiplier and, for `abitazione_principale_A1_A8_A9`, whether the tax is due (only A1, A8, A9) or the home is exempt. `A` without a number applies to dwellings when the number is unknown; if missing, it is computed as `A` and the response says so. Not used with `terreno_agricolo` and `area_edificabile`.

rendita_catastale.description: Buildings: annual cadastral income (rendita catastale) in euro (from the visura). REQUIRED for all types other than `terreno_agricolo` and `area_edificabile` — i.e. also for the default type `abitazione_non_principale`.

reddito_dominicale.description: Agricultural land: reddito dominicale from the visura (base = ×1.25×135). REQUIRED with `tipo_immobile: terreno_agricolo`, except when the land is exempt (see the two flags).

valore_venale.description: Building land: market value as of 1 January (€). REQUIRED with `tipo_immobile: area_edificabile`.

mesi_possesso.description: Months of ownership in the year (default 12). With partial ownership it does not say WHICH months: to split the first and second instalment use mese_inizio/mese_fine.

mese_inizio.description: First month of ownership counted (1 = January; a month counts if owned for more than half its days). With mese_fine the June instalment becomes the tax for the first half-year (L. 160/2019 c. 762). Default 1.

mese_fine.description: Last month of ownership counted (12 = December). Default 12.

detrazione.description: Deduction in euro (buildings only; e.g. 200 for a luxury main residence).

coltivatore_diretto_iap.description: Land: coltivatore diretto/IAP farmer enrolled in agricultural social security → exempt.

esente_montano_isola.description: Land: in a mountain/hill municipality or minor island → exempt.

tools.name: compose_f24
tools.description: Composes the LINES of the Italian F24 payment form (Erario, INPS, IMU sections) with the official tax codes and causali, starting from amounts already computed (code meanings below are the Italian labels the tool returns): substitute tax and contributions of the regime forfettario (codici tributo 1790 = acconto prima rata, 1791 = acconto seconda rata o unica soluzione, 1792 = saldo; causali INPS PXX = Gestione Separata senza altra copertura, AF = artigiani sul minimale, AP = artigiani sull'eccedenza, CF = commercianti sul minimale, CP = commercianti sull'eccedenza) or IMU (3912 = abitazione principale e pertinenze (A/1, A/8, A/9), 3918 = altri fabbricati, 3914 = terreni, 3916 = aree fabbricabili; for group D 3925 = quota Stato (7,6‰) and 3930 = incremento Comune; with the municipality's cadastral code) or the STAMP DUTY (imposta di bollo) on the e-invoices of a quarter (2521 = primo trimestre, 2522 = secondo trimestre, 2523 = terzo trimestre, 2524 = quarto trimestre; deadlines 31/05 · 30/09 · 30/11 · 28/02, with the deferral rule below €5,000). For the forfettario the response also carries `regola_acconti`: the two 50% instalments apply to businesses whose activity has approved ISA (also in the forfettario), otherwise 40% and 60% — with the law and the calculation base. Returns structured lines (section, code, year, amount, indicative deadline) + a text rendering. COMPOSABLE: the typical input is the output of `calc_forfettario` (imposta_sostitutiva.importo, contributi_inps), `calc_imu` (imu_dovuta, acconto_giugno, saldo_dicembre) and `parse_fatturapa` (how many invoices have `bollo_analisi.dovuto = true`). It does NOT generate the official F24 form — neither PDF nor official facsimile: it is an INDICATIVE compilation that does not replace the accountant or checking with the Agenzia delle Entrate. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

kind.description: Domain to compose: 'forfettario' (Erario + INPS), 'imu' (IMU and other local taxes section) or 'bollo' (stamp duty on the e-invoices of a quarter).

bollo.description: Required when kind='bollo'. Closes the chain parse → stamp duty → F24: count how many invoices of the quarter are subject to stamp duty according to `parse_fatturapa` (field `bollo_analisi.dovuto` of each invoice) and compose the payment line.

trimestre.description: Calendar quarter (1-4). It sets the codice tributo: 2521 = primo trimestre, 2522 = secondo trimestre, 2523 = terzo trimestre, 2524 = quarto trimestre.

anno.description: Year of the invoices (e.g. 2026). NB: the 4th quarter is paid by 28 February of the FOLLOWING year.

numero_fatture.description: How many invoices of the quarter are subject to stamp duty (€2.00 each). Alternative to `importo`: provide at least one of the two.

importo.description: Stamp duty amount already computed, in euro. Alternative to `numero_fatture`. If you pass both and they do not match, this one wins and the discrepancy is reported in a note.

importo_trimestri_precedenti.description: Stamp duty already due for the previous quarters of the same year (default 0). Used by the deferral rule, which looks at the CUMULATIVE amount: below €5,000 the 1st-quarter payment can move to 30/09 and that of 1st+2nd to 30/11 (art. 3 DL 73/2022). The 3rd and 4th quarter can never be deferred.

forfettario.description: Required when kind='forfettario'. Fields from the output of calc_forfettario.

imposta.description: Substitute tax due in euro — calc_forfettario → imposta_sostitutiva.importo.

gestione_inps.description: Pension scheme (default gestione_separata) — it sets the causali INPS (PXX = Gestione Separata senza altra copertura; AF = artigiani sul minimale, AP = artigiani sull'eccedenza; CF = commercianti sul minimale, CP = commercianti sull'eccedenza). With cassa_privata there is no INPS line: those contributions are not paid via F24.

inps_fisso.description: INPS contributions on the minimum/fixed part in euro — calc_forfettario → contributi_inps.fisso.

inps_variabile.description: INPS contributions on the excess in euro — calc_forfettario → contributi_inps.variabile.

inps_totale.description: Total INPS contributions in euro — calc_forfettario → contributi_inps.importo. Used only if fisso/variabile are not provided.

startup.description: First year of activity: no advance payments, only the balance is paid. It is not the 5% rate (which lasts five years): here the tax arrives already computed.

imu.description: Required when kind='imu'. Fields from the output of calc_imu.

imu_dovuta.description: Annual IMU due in euro — calc_imu → imu_dovuta.

acconto.description: June instalment in euro — calc_imu → acconto_giugno.

saldo.description: December balance in euro — calc_imu → saldo_dicembre.

base_imponibile.description: Taxable base in euro — calc_imu → base_imponibile. Used for the group D split.

aliquota_permille.description: Rate set by the municipality, per thousand — calc_imu → parametri.aliquota_permille. Used for the group D split (7.6‰ State + municipal excess).

tipo_immobile.description: Property type — calc_imu → parametri.tipo_immobile. It sets the IMU codice tributo.

codice_comune.description: Cadastral/Belfiore code of the municipality = F24 codice ente (1 letter + 3 digits, e.g. H501 for Rome).

tools.name: intrastat_periodicity
tools.description: Determines whether a business must file the Italian INTRASTAT summary listing and how often (monthly / quarterly / no obligation), from the amounts of the four previous quarters, and computes the period DEADLINE (25th of the following month, moved when it falls on a Saturday, Sunday or Italian national holiday). Each flow has its own threshold and criterion, returned together with the legal SOURCE: sales of goods and services rendered €50,000 with an EXCEEDS criterion (>) → monthly if exceeded, otherwise quarterly; purchases of services €100,000 and purchases of goods €2,000,000 (threshold raised from €350,000 from reference period 01/2026, Det. ADM 84415 of 03/02/2026) with an EQUAL OR GREATER criterion (>=) → monthly if reached, otherwise NO obligation (for purchases the quarterly frequency was abolished). The > / >= asymmetry is intentional and mirrors the sources. Indicative: it does not replace the accountant or customs broker. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

flusso.description: 'cessioni' = outgoing transactions, INTRA-1 forms (goods sold / services rendered); 'acquisti' = incoming transactions, INTRA-2 forms (goods purchased / services received).

categoria.description: Category of the transactions (beni = goods, servizi = services). Threshold and form section depend on it.

anno.description: Year of the REFERENCE period (not of the filing). The current forms apply from 2022. It decides which INTRA-2bis threshold applies (2,000,000 from 2026).

mese.description: Month of the reference period (1–12). If the frequency turns out quarterly, the quarter is derived from this month.

ammontari_trimestri_precedenti.description: Amounts in EURO of the four PREVIOUS quarters for that flow+category, ordered from most recent to oldest (e.g. [62000, 41000, 38000, 35000]). From 1 to 4 values allowed: a business that started recently has fewer, and the response flags it in the notes. The threshold is assessed on the MAXIMUM, not on the sum.

tools.name: intrastat_compose
tools.description: Composes the SECTIONS of the Italian INTRASTAT summary listing from transaction lines, assigning each line to the right section (INTRA-1bis sales of goods, 1ter corrections, 1quater services rendered, 1quinquies corrections, 1sexies call-off stock; INTRA-2bis purchases of goods, 2ter, 2quater services received, 2quinquies) and VALIDATING them: allowed Member State (Northern Ireland XI only for GOODS; San Marino and the United Kingdom are out of scope), counterparty VAT number (format per Member State + checksum for Italian ones), 8-digit combined nomenclature (or the simplified code 99500000), format of the nature of transaction and required fields per section. Returns the populated sections, the totals, the deadline and a text summary for review. ⚠️ It does NOT generate the ELECTRONIC file for the customs telematic service (Intr@Web / ADM): the official record layout cannot be reproduced from a verifiable public source, so it was not invented. What you get is a data structure + summary, to be transferred to the official channel. No silent defaults: a missing required field produces an explicit error, never an arbitrary fill-in. VAT numbers are validated OFFLINE (format and checksum): for the live VIES check of the counterparty use `verify_payee`. Determine the frequency first with `intrastat_periodicity`. Indicative, it does not replace the accountant or customs broker. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

anno.description: Year of the reference period (the current forms apply from 2022).

mese.description: Month of the reference period (1–12). With quarterly frequency it identifies the quarter.

periodicita.description: Filing frequency of the listing — determine it with `intrastat_periodicity`. With 'nessun_obbligo' the call is REJECTED with an explanation: below the threshold the listing is not filed.

partita_iva_dichiarante.description: Italian VAT number of the filer (11 digits, optional). If provided it is validated with the checksum.

righe.description: Transaction lines to summarise. Maximum 25 on the anonymous surface (the authenticated API has no such limit). Lines of different flows/categories can coexist: each ends up in its own section.

categoria.description: Decides which fields are required: GOODS (beni) fields and SERVICES (servizi) fields are mutually exclusive.

rettifica.description: True if the line corrects a PREVIOUS period → ter/quinquies sections. Requires `anno_riferimento_rettifica`. Only corrections may have a negative amount.

call_off_stock.description: Sales of GOODS only: call-off stock regime (art. 17-bis Dir. 2006/112/EC) → section INTRA-1sexies.

paese_controparte.description: ISO2 code of the counterparty's Member State (e.g. DE, FR, ES; EL for Greece, not GR). 'XI' (Northern Ireland) is allowed ONLY for goods. SM (San Marino) and GB are out of scope and rejected.

partita_iva_controparte.description: Counterparty VAT number, with or without country prefix (e.g. DE123456789 or 123456789). Validated against the Member State format; Italian ones also with the checksum. No VIES query.

ammontare.description: Amount of the transactions in EURO. Negative allowed only if rettifica=true.

nomenclatura_combinata.description: GOODS only: 8-digit CN code. For consignments worth less than €1,000 the single code 99500000 is allowed. The FORMAT is validated, not its existence in the year's CN (the CN table is annual and not in the repository).

massa_netta_kg.description: GOODS only: net mass in kg.

paese_origine.description: GOODS only: country of origin of the goods (ISO2).

paese_destinazione.description: GOODS only: country of destination/provenance of the goods (ISO2).

natura_transazione.description: GOODS only: nature of transaction code — 1 digit (column A) or 2 digits (columns A+B, required above €20,000,000 of trade in the previous year). ONLY the format is validated: the code descriptions are Annex XI to Det. ADM 493869/RU/2021, not reproducible from a verifiable text source, and are not invented.

codice_servizio.description: SERVICES only: 6-digit CPA code. The format is validated, not its existence in the CPA table.

modalita_incasso.description: SERVICES only: 'B' bank transfer · 'A' credit · 'X' other.

anno_riferimento_rettifica.description: Required if rettifica=true: year of the corrected period.

riferimento.description: Free reference (e.g. invoice number). Only for your own traceability: it is not part of the listing.

tools.name: intrastat_reference
tools.description: Returns, with no input, the INTRASTAT reference tables: the allowed Member States with their codes, the Northern Ireland case (XI, goods only) and the out-of-scope countries (San Marino from 01/10/2021, United Kingdom from 01/01/2021), all form sections with their description, and EVERY current threshold with amount, comparison criterion (> or >=), effect and precise legal SOURCE — including the goods-purchase threshold raised to €2,000,000 from period 01/2026 (Det. ADM 84415 of 03/02/2026). It also includes the filing deadline and the EXPLICIT list of what these tools do NOT produce (the ADM electronic file, the descriptions of the nature of transaction codes, the live VIES check). Use it to validate inputs before `intrastat_compose`, to populate a form, or to cite the source of a threshold instead of recalling it from memory. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

tools.name: nis2_tipologie
tools.description: Official list of the entity types in annexes I–IV of Italian D.Lgs. 4 settembre 2024 n. 138 (NIS2 transposition), verbatim from the Gazzetta Ufficiale text (in Italian), with text search. Use it to find the `tipologia_id` to pass to `nis2_ambito`. ⚠️ There is NO ATECO code → entity type map, and this tool does not use one: the declaration on the ACN platform (art. 11 c. 2 of ACN determination 314287/2026) keeps ATECO codes and entity types SEPARATE, and scope is determined by the ENTITY TYPE, defined by reference to an EU rule. Inferring NIS2 scope from an ATECO code means applying a rule the source does not contain. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

q.description: Text search over entity type text, sector and subsector, in Italian (accents and case ignored; all terms must appear). E.g. 'cloud', 'energia elettrica', 'rifiuti'. Empty = the whole catalogue.

query.description: Alias di `q` (testo da cercare): stesso dato, accettato perché altri tool di questo server lo chiamano così. Se mandi entrambi i nomi, i valori devono coincidere.

allegato.description: Filter by annex. I = sectors of high criticality (51 types); II = other critical sectors (15); III = public administrations (15); IV = further types, in scope only if identified by the ACN (4).

tools.name: nis2_ambito
tools.description: Tells whether an entity falls within the scope of Italian D.Lgs. 138/2024 (NIS2) and whether it is an ESSENTIAL or IMPORTANT entity, citing ARTICLE AND PARAGRAPH for every step of the reasoning. When a datum that would change the answer is missing it returns `esito: "indeterminato"` (undetermined) and the QUESTION to ask, instead of an invented answer. `in_ambito` answers the scope question on its own: true (in scope — with `esito: "indeterminato"` only the category is still open), false (out), null (scope itself undetermined). The rules most often got wrong, all applied here: (1) the ENTRY threshold is that of the SMALL enterprise, not the medium one — an entity is in with headcount >= 50 OR (turnover > €10M AND balance sheet > €10M) — so the scope is much wider than usually described; (2) exceeding a ceiling requires headcount above threshold OR BOTH financial values above threshold: 30 employees with €12M turnover and €8M balance sheet is still SMALL, so OUT; (3) art. 3 §4 of Recommendation 2003/361/EC is DISAPPLIED (art. 3 c. 3): a public shareholding of 25% or more does not remove SME status; (4) an annex II entity is NEVER essential by size — art. 6 c. 1 lett. a) cites only annex I — not even with thousands of employees. It registers nothing with the ACN (Italian national cybersecurity agency): it is the pre-flight of the declaration, whose preliminary assessment is performed automatically by the ACN platform (art. 11 c. 6 of ACN determination 314287/2026); inclusion or not in the list of NIS entities is then notified by the ACN (art. 15 c. 3 of the determination). Indicative, not legal advice. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

tipologia_id.description: Entity type id from the official list — get it with `nis2_tipologie`. E.g. 'I.1.a.1' (electricity undertaking), 'III.a.2' (Ministries). It is NOT an ATECO code.

bilancio_eur.description: Annual balance sheet total in euro.

impresa_autonoma.description: false if the entity has linked or partner enterprises: art. 3 c. 4 then requires consolidation under art. 6 §2 of the Recommendation. Omit it if you do not know — the tool asks. An exceedance already visible on individual data stays valid (consolidation can only increase the values); a NON-exceedance does not.

dati_consolidati.description: true if the size values provided are ALREADY consolidated at group level.

soggetto_critico_cer.description: true if the entity is identified as a critical entity under the decree that transposes Directive (EU) 2022/2557 (CER): it is in scope and ESSENTIAL regardless of size (art. 3 c. 5 lett. a; art. 6 c. 1 lett. b).

prestatore_fiduciario_qualificato.description: Only for trust service providers: QUALIFIED ones are essential regardless of size (art. 6 c. 1 lett. d), non-qualified ones are not.

individuato_da_acn.description: true if the national NIS competent authority has notified the identification (art. 3 c. 13). For annex IV it is THE scope condition: without it, scope cannot be self-assessed and the tool says so instead of guessing.

criteri_impresa_collegata.description: Letters of art. 3 c. 10 met when the entity is a linked enterprise of an essential or important entity: a) dominant influence over decisions on risk-management measures; b) holds or operates the systems on which the service provision depends; c) performs its cybersecurity operations; d) provides it with ICT or security services. Even a single letter brings it in scope regardless of size.

tools.name: nis2_reference
tools.description: Returns, with no input, the NIS2 size thresholds with the exact exceedance formula and the source (Recommendation 2003/361/EC, annex, art. 2 §1 and §2, reproduced verbatim in the notes to art. 6 in the Gazzetta Ufficiale), the rule of every relevant paragraph of art. 3 and art. 6, the four linked-enterprise criteria, the registration window on the ACN platform (1 January to 28 February of EVERY year: it recurs, it is not a one-off deadline) and the EXPLICIT list of what this domain does NOT cover. It includes the case of sectors 3 and 4 of annex I (banking and financial market infrastructures), for which art. 3 c. 14 replaces art. 17 and Chapters IV and V with Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 (DORA). Use it to cite the source of a threshold instead of recalling it from memory. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

tools.name: verify_payee
tools.description: Anti-fraud check of a payee BEFORE paying an invoice (against IBAN-change fraud / Business Email Compromise). Checks: IBAN (MOD-97 checksum + bank from the Italian ABI code), Italian VAT number (Partita IVA) and Codice Fiscale (checksum), and — when the EU service is reachable — the real company name via live VIES with a match against the expected name. Returns a verdict (ok / non_verificabile / attenzione / alto_rischio) + the specific red flags. `non_verificabile` (unverifiable) = no fraud signal BUT no authoritative source confirmed who the supplier is (Italian VAT number not registered in VIES, or no VAT number given): it is not an alarm, it is the refusal to say "ok" about an unidentified party. Unlike the other tools it performs external I/O (VIES): if VIES is down or the verification budget is temporarily exhausted, the verdict HONESTLY degrades to "attenzione" (warning), never a false "ok". Free (€0), no login. It does NOT replace out-of-band verification (calling the supplier on an already-known number).

vat_number.description: VAT number with or without country prefix (e.g. IT12345678901).

partita_iva.description: Alias di `vat_number` (Partita IVA): stesso dato, accettato perché altri tool di questo server lo chiamano così. Se mandi entrambi i nomi, i valori devono coincidere.

expected_name.description: Supplier's expected company name, compared with the official VIES one.

expected_country.description: Supplier's expected country in ISO2 (default IT). A foreign IBAN is fraud red flag #1.

ateco.description: Supplier's declared ATECO activity code (digits and dots only, optional).

codice_ateco.description: Alias di `ateco` (codice ATECO): stesso dato, accettato perché altri tool di questo server lo chiamano così. Se mandi entrambi i nomi, i valori devono coincidere.

tools.name: guardian_list_suppliers
tools.description: Lists the suppliers this account is watching, with the status of the most recent VIES check and how many IBANs are confirmed or awaiting confirmation. IBANs are returned MASKED. Requires an API key (free account at https://imperioutils.com/signup). Consumes no credits.

only_alerting.description: If true, returns only the suppliers that need attention; the reason is in `attention_reasons`: iban_da_confermare (an IBAN awaiting confirmation), iban_rifiutato (a rejected IBAN that reappeared on a document), stato_vies_non_ok (the last VIES check reported a problem), mai_verificato (supplier just added: the first VIES check runs in the nightly sweep — it is NOT a negative outcome, and until then `vies_observable` is null).

tools.name: guardian_supplier_ledger
tools.description: The history of IBANs seen for a supplier: which are confirmed, which are awaiting human confirmation, which were rejected, and since when. It is the memory a new IBAN is judged against. IBANs are MASKED (country, bank, last 4 digits). Requires an API key (free account at https://imperioutils.com/signup). Consumes no credits.

partita_iva.description: Supplier's Italian VAT number (Partita IVA, with or without IT prefix).

vat_number.description: Alias di `partita_iva` (Partita IVA): stesso dato, accettato perché altri tool di questo server lo chiamano così. Se mandi entrambi i nomi, i valori devono coincidere.

tools.name: guardian_supplier_status
tools.description: Tells whether a supplier is watched by this account and how the last check went: VIES outcome, whether the answer was authoritative, since when none has been obtained, and any anomalies detected. Requires an API key (free account at https://imperioutils.com/signup). Consumes no credits.

partita_iva.description: Supplier's Italian VAT number (Partita IVA, with or without IT prefix).

vat_number.description: Alias di `partita_iva` (Partita IVA): stesso dato, accettato perché altri tool di questo server lo chiamano così. Se mandi entrambi i nomi, i valori devono coincidere.

tools.name: guardian_check_iban
tools.description: The anti-BEC step: compares the IBAN read on an invoice with that supplier's history and says whether it is already confirmed, seen but never confirmed, or NEVER SEEN. WARNING, this tool CHANGES state: a never-seen IBAN is recorded as "awaiting confirmation" and the account holder receives a warning email. Confirming an IBAN is NOT exposed to agents: it is an act that requires a person, and is done at https://imperioutils.com/tools/supplier-monitors. Requires an API key (free account at https://imperioutils.com/signup). Consumes no credits.

iban.description: IBAN shown on the document to be paid.

partita_iva.description: Supplier's Italian VAT number (Partita IVA, with or without IT prefix).

vat_number.description: Alias di `partita_iva` (Partita IVA): stesso dato, accettato perché altri tool di questo server lo chiamano così. Se mandi entrambi i nomi, i valori devono coincidere.

tools.name: guardian_watch_supplier
tools.description: Registers one or more suppliers with the guardian, so that their IBAN changes and VIES changes are caught by the nightly checks. The IBANs given enter the ledger as "awaiting confirmation", NEVER as confirmed: an IBAN read on a document is not a baseline. What is left out (plan full, already watched, missing identity) is returned counted and with the reason. Requires an API key (free account at https://imperioutils.com/signup). Consumes no credits.

suppliers.description: The suppliers to watch. Each needs the Partita IVA (VAT number) or the Codice Fiscale.

partita_iva.description: Supplier's Italian VAT number (Partita IVA, with or without IT prefix).

expected_country.description: Supplier's EXPECTED country (ISO-2). Defaults to IT if omitted. It is the country a foreign IBAN is judged against: declaring it avoids false alerts on legitimately foreign suppliers.

iban.description: IBAN read on the document. It enters the ledger as "awaiting confirmation".
